method: Artwork-level crops taken from the original source composites, isolated by content bounds against the detected background, registered on an identical canvas. No generative redraw, no inpainting, no pixel erasure.

pairs.name: pixel-heart
pairs.title: Pixel Heart
limitations: A background grid is baked into the raster half of the source poster and crosses the artwork; it is preserved, not erased.
The clean half retains visible vector control-point markers in the source image.
The two heart shapes are not identical outlines, so registration aligns them by content bounds rather than by contour.

pairs.name: apple
pairs.title: Apple
limitations: The clean half retains visible vector control-point and anchor markers in the source image.
The raster half is an intentionally blurred/upscaled bitmap, so detail is not recoverable by registration.

pairs.name: cityscape
pairs.title: City Skyline
limitations: The raster half carries a full-panel noise/grain texture that cannot be removed without redrawing.
Building silhouettes differ between the two halves; the residual mismatch is disclosed rather than warped away.

pairs.name: bird
pairs.title: Bird Illustration
limitations: The source crops the lower stems: the black RASTER/VECTOR label blocks of the poster occlude the stem region and are excluded, which also cuts the artwork short.
Visible vector control points remain on the clean half.

pairs.name: apple-illustrator
pairs.title: Apple — vector editor
limitations: This source is a screenshot of a vector editor; only the artwork region is extracted and all editor chrome, canvas borders and Before/After captions are excluded.
Control points, anchor markers and a selection bounding box are visible on the clean half and are preserved.

pairs.name: deer-full
pairs.title: Red Deer — full
limitations: The clean half has a red cut-layer outline baked into the source artwork; it is preserved, not removed.
The raster half is a low-resolution render of the same artwork, so edges stay soft.

pairs.name: deer-detail
pairs.title: Red Deer — antler detail
limitations: The clean half has a red cut-layer outline baked into the source artwork; it is preserved, not removed.
The detail crop is registered on the antler mass, which sits left of centre in each panel, not on the panel centre.

pairs.name: cursor-full
pairs.title: Cursor — full shape
limitations: The source arranges this pair by rows (raster above, clean below), not left/right.
Magnification boxes and leader lines are drawn over the raster half in the source; they are preserved where they cross the artwork.
The zoom captions and panel furniture of the source are excluded.

pairs.name: cursor-zoom
pairs.title: Cursor — magnified detail
limitations: The two halves of this pair show different visible background and transparency in the source, so the detail itself does not sit on identical backgrounds.
The 8x magnification captions are excluded.

pairs.name: eagle
pairs.title: Eagle Logo
limitations: The raster half is a blurred bitmap in the source; the softness is real and is preserved.
Control points remain visible on the clean half.

pairs.name: s-letter
pairs.title: Letter S
limitations: The purple taper illustration and the embedded small S are part of the source artwork and are preserved.
The outer frame and the Raster/Vector format captions of the source are excluded.

excluded_sources.reason: Two mirrored fox illustrations with directional controls; no verified before/after relationship and no demonstrated quality difference in the source. Excluded pending confirmation of provenance.
